patterns.rotation_pattern: 4 of 10 cards (40%) are in LANDSCAPE orientation and require 90 degree counter-clockwise rotation: ice_cream_flinger, shofario, wonka_wacka_doodle_monster, robo_jolt. The remaining 6 cards are already in correct PORTRAIT orientation. The current detect_rotation() function correctly identifies landscape images but the rotation may not be applying correctly.
patterns.orientation_detection: Simple width > height check is CORRECT for detecting landscape images. All landscape images consistently need 90_ccw rotation to orient properly.

portrait_cards.description: For already-portrait cards, crop from ~10% from top (below title) to ~45% from bottom (above abilities). Side margins of ~6% work well.

landscape_cards_after_rotation.description: After rotating landscape cards, the character box is more centered but abilities text takes up significant right portion. Need asymmetric crop.

universal_safe_crop.description: A conservative universal crop that should capture the character box on most cards without cutting into it. May include some title/ability text on edge cases.

issues_found: ROTATION ISSUE: The current script rotates by 90 degrees counter-clockwise which should be correct, but PIL's rotate() with expand=True may have unexpected behavior. Need to verify the rotation is actually being applied and saved correctly.

CROPPING RATIOS WRONG: Current heuristic uses top_margin=12%, bottom_margin=38% which leaves only 50% of height. For portrait cards, character box is typically from ~10% to ~55% (45% of card height). The current bottom_margin of 38% is cutting into character boxes.

LANDSCAPE CARD LAYOUT DIFFERENT: Landscape cards (after rotation) have a different layout - the character box is more square/centered with abilities text to the side rather than below. The same cropping ratios will not work.

COLOR DETECTION UNRELIABLE: The doublespike card has a gray/pencil border with low saturation. Color-based border detection may fail on this card. The find_colored_border_box() function's min_saturation=50 threshold may miss it.
SPECIAL CASES: the_scribbler has intentional artwork extending outside the box frame. Aggressive cropping will cut off important visual elements.
BOX ASPECT RATIOS VARY: Some character boxes are more rectangular/wide (spike_wall, box, doublespike) while others are more square. A fixed crop ratio cannot accommodate all.

script_bugs_identified.issue: Function returns 90 for landscape images, intending CCW rotation. However, need to verify this is the correct direction for all landscape cards.
script_bugs_identified.recommendation: Test with actual images to confirm 90 CCW produces correct orientation.

script_bugs_identified.issue: Heuristic ratios are incorrect. top_margin=12%, bottom_margin=38% means the crop box is from y=12% to y=62% of image height. This should be adjusted.
script_bugs_identified.recommendation: Change to top_margin=10%, bottom_margin=45% for portrait cards to capture full character box.

script_bugs_identified.issue: min_saturation=50 may be too high for pencil/gray borders like doublespike card.
script_bugs_identified.recommendation: Lower to min_saturation=30 or add edge detection as fallback.

script_bugs_identified.issue: The heuristic method does not account for the different layouts between portrait-shot and landscape-shot cards.
script_bugs_identified.recommendation: After rotation, detect if the original was landscape and use different crop ratios.

recommended_fixes.1_rotation: Keep current rotation logic (90 CCW for landscape) but add metadata tracking to know if image was originally landscape.
recommended_fixes.2_cropping_portrait: For cards that were already portrait: top=10%, bottom=45%, left=6%, right=6%
recommended_fixes.3_cropping_rotated_landscape: For cards that were rotated from landscape: top=8%, bottom=8%, left=15%, right=35% - this accounts for the different layout where abilities are on the side.
recommended_fixes.4_border_detection: Improve border detection by: (a) lowering saturation threshold to 30, (b) adding edge detection fallback, (c) looking for rectangular shapes rather than just color.
recommended_fixes.5_special_cases: Add card-specific overrides for cards like the_scribbler that have artwork extending outside the box.

portrait_shot_cards.layout: Title at top (~8-10%), character box below (~10-55%), abilities below box (~55-100%)

landscape_shot_cards.layout_after_rotation: Title on left side (now top after rotation), character box center-left, abilities on right side (now bottom after rotation)
landscape_shot_cards.recommended_crop: These cards have a fundamentally different layout after rotation. The character box is more centered and abilities wrap around it differently. May need card-specific handling.
landscape_shot_cards.alternative: Consider not rotating and instead extracting the character box from the landscape orientation directly.
